history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1830 in Missouri and came to Chicago about 1857. He works as a packing house hand, and the household lives in the blocks about State and Madison streets. The family's church is Quinn Chapel.
